## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Content update
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor/maintenance
- [ ] Documentation

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm run serve` smoke-check completed
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visible UI/content changes (if applicable)

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and minimal
- [ ] Related docs updated (`README.md` or other docs) if needed
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data introduced

## Related Issues

Link issue(s): `Closes #...` / `Related #...`
